source: docs/00_PRD.md §15.2 (copied verbatim; do not edit questions without recording why)

cases.question: How does a large customer get connected to the grid in New Zealand?
cases.expected_behavior: 按资料覆盖范围解释流程，区分 transmission 与 distribution 路径，避免声称所有公司流程完全相同

cases.question: Who is involved in the connection process, and what does each party do?
cases.expected_behavior: 引用机构职责或流程文件，区分申请方、电网/配电方及其他资料明确的参与者

cases.question: What steps or constraints can delay a large-load connection?
cases.expected_behavior: 仅列出有来源支持的环节，区分可能原因与经过测量的延误

cases.question: What public capacity information is available from NZ network companies, and in what format?
cases.expected_behavior: 列举已审核入口或说明文档、数据格式、日期及限制，不把地图入口等同于完整可分析数据

cases.question: What does hosting capacity mean in the sources we have reviewed?
cases.expected_behavior: 保留原文定义和适用场景，区分新增负荷与发电接入资料

cases.question: How do firm and flexible connections differ in the reviewed material?
cases.expected_behavior: 指出资料中的合同/运行条件与地区，不给出跨网络无条件保证

cases.question: How is curtailment described as a way to accommodate additional load?
cases.expected_behavior: 解释已审核研究中的机制、假设和限制，不输出未验证的 NZ 容量增益

cases.question: What do the reviewed sources say about N-1 and N-2 redundancy?
cases.expected_behavior: 引用定义与适用边界，不声称可直接由术语推算具体站点容量

cases.question: Can a new 100 MW data centre connect at a specified NZ site next month?
cases.expected_behavior: 语料缺少站点研究时不回答确定容量或日期；列出所缺信息

cases.question: What is the exact available capacity at that substation today?
cases.expected_behavior: 无当前站点数据时指出无法确定；不把历史资料作为实时值

cases.question: Does this US connection policy automatically apply to New Zealand?
cases.expected_behavior: 在仅有美国材料且无 NZ 依据的测试条件下，不断言适用；指出地区证据缺口

cases.question: What exact curtailment hours and connection date will the utility offer this project?
cases.expected_behavior: 语料无该项目正式条件时拒绝编造数值与承诺；说明需取得何种材料

cases.question: Which side, utility or data centre, shows the sharper pain and a plausible champion?
cases.expected_behavior: 研究讨论题：区分公开证据、假设和需访谈验证的判断

cases.question: What do EPRI DCFlex and the Duke research contribute to our research questions?
cases.expected_behavior: 仅在对应材料已批准时回答，归纳方法与适用限制

cases.question: What evidence is still missing before choosing a prototype direction?
cases.expected_behavior: 基于当前库和缺口记录列出下一步，不宣称穷尽所有行业问题
